messages:
sam_newhire: Hey all — first week. Running into two setup things: Okta keeps saying 'No security key found' when I try to enroll my YubiKey, and I also can't open the onboarding Google Drive folder (access denied). Who should I ping?
jenna-ops: Welcome! @it-oncall for the key, @it-identity for provisioning. Which OS/browser + YubiKey model?
sam_newhire: macOS 13.5, Chrome (stable), YubiKey 5 NFC via a USB-C adapter. I rebooted and tried different ports already.
it-oncall: Quick checklist: 1) Try incognito 2) Try Safari 3) Remove the adapter if you can 4) paste any Okta error text if present.
sam_newhire: Okta modal only says 'No security key found' (no error code). Drive link from onboarding email gives 'You don't have access'.
mike-devex: Drive access often waits on SCIM provisioning. You should get Google Workspaces welcome email and the shared folder once provisioning finishes. Did you get that welcome mail?
sam_newhire: I got a welcome email but it was pretty minimal. No drive links.
jenna-ops: If SCIM/Google provisioning hasn't finished, 1Password/Drive can be missing. @it-identity can force a sync. For the YubiKey: Safari sometimes handles WebAuthn differently than Chrome.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email sent to sam@redwood.com at 1763009560.
it-identity: I queued a SCIM sync for sam@redwood.com and forced Google provisioning — should finish in ~5 minutes. I also see repeated FIDO attempts from your IP that didn't complete. Can you try the YubiKey without the USB adapter or via phone NFC?
sam_newhire: Tried without adapter on a hub -> same. Phone NFC also says 'Tap failed'.
it-oncall: Can you run this and paste the output?
```
system_profiler SPUSBDataType | grep -i yubikey -A3
```

sam_newhire: Output shows USB device present: "Yubico YubiKey 5" under Apple USB-C Hub.
it-oncall: Good — hardware visible. Next: clear site permissions for okta.redwood.com in Chrome (Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings → USB and Security keys) and then try again. Sometimes Chrome blocks USB devices for a site. Also try an incognito window.
sam_newhire: Clearing site permissions + incognito did the trick — Okta asked me to touch the key, registration succeeded. Thanks!
it-identity: I pushed the final group assignment; you should now have access to the onboarding Drive folder. Log out/in of your Google session if you still see 'access denied'.
sam_newhire: I can open the folder and I got the 1Password invite. Woo! Quick Q: where should I store YubiKey backup codes (company preference)?
mike-devex: Store them in the company 1Password vault under an "MFA Backup" item. Follow the docs in #eng-security for labels/retention. If it's very sensitive, mark as restricted.
sam_newhire: Awesome — saved them in the company vault. Thanks everyone :party_parrot: Closing this thread.
